open.acknowledgement: none; fire-and-forget (Host returns null to AS2; failures arrive as gameCommand ragChatUnavailable)

hostOpenChain.preflight: health probe (<=1.5s) -> launch CFN-RAG-v*.exe --embedded -> poll health (<=20s, 500ms) -> POST /api/integration/bind (single retry)
hostOpenChain.threading: runs on ThreadPool off the synchronous panel_request transition lock; OpenPanel marshalled back to the UI thread; navigation-baseline check abandons a stale open

binding.payload: {slot_key, character?: {name: string, ...}, progress?: {tasks_finished: number[], task_chains_progress: object, tasks_active?: number[]}, scene?: {stageFlag: string, stageName: string, entrance: string, inCombat: boolean}, player?: object}
binding.semantics: idempotent; same slot_key = projection refresh; absent section clears it (replace, not merge) — refresh senders must carry every projection section they know
binding.writeState: exe memory only (never the game save)
binding.businessDecisionOwner: Host (exe memory state follows Host lifecycle)

projectionRefresh.payload: {savePath, character?, progress?, scene?, player?} — same whitelist as open initData
points: boot handshake savePath commit (bind refresh only; boot loaders read the slot overlay directly)
SaveManager.replacePlayerContext slot switch (bind refresh + _root.重新加载任务数据)
SaveManager flush ok (local SharedObject commit point)
_root.提交任务完成状态 (real task completions; UpdateTaskProgress without id does not fire it)
projectionRefresh.semantics: best-effort and idempotent; single POST, never launches the exe, exe offline silently skipped, failures log-only and never toast back to AS2

taskCompleted.payload: {savePath, taskId: integer, npc?: string} — Host whitelist TryParseRagTaskCompleted rejects unknown keys; npc is a fallback name only (the terminal treats the task record's get_npc as authoritative)
taskCompleted.sendPoint: _root.提交任务完成状态 (the single authoritative tasks_finished write, reached from TaskRewardCommit.finish); AS2 gates on the Agent commission id range 200001-300000, so main-line/side/dungeon completions never reach the wire
taskCompleted.semantics: query; changes no game state and awaits no reply. Best-effort: single POST with no retry (the terminal owns idempotency per (slot_key, task_id)), never launches the exe, exe offline silently skipped, malformed payload / unwired service / post failure all log-only and never toast back to AS2. Response is always 200 with {ok, accepted, detail, job_id}; accepted=false is normal (slot mismatch, no rewrite marker, rate limit) and the Host only logs it

dialogueChanged.versionSignal: data/rag/sync_state.json 的 dialogue_version（与 task_publish_version 同一把写锁、同一文件，缺键按 0）

as2ToHost.payload: {savePath: string, dialogueVersion: integer} — Host 白名单 TryParseRagDialogueChanged 未知键整包拒收；dialogueVersion 必须是非负整数
as2ToHost.sendPoint: 通信_aka_Agent联动.as 轮询同步状态：同一次 LoadVars 读取解析两个版本，dialogue_version 与基线不同即发一次；首次读取只建立基线，槽位变化重置基线，发送失败不推进基线、下一轮 7 秒轮询重试
as2ToHost.hostEffect: savePath 必须等于 AgentSaveContext.CurrentSlotKey，否则忽略并记日志；命中后只调 AgentDialogueOverrides.Invalidate()（base XML 与 DataCache 一律不动）

hostToAs2.transport: gameCommand（Host->AS2 cmd），best-effort 单次，发送失败只记日志
hostToAs2.handler: _root.gameCommands["agentDialogueChanged"] → _root.agent.处理对话覆盖层变更 → _root.agent.刷新已绑定NPC对话（只遍历登记表；不重载 base XML、不清 DataCache）
hostToAs2.semantics: query；不改游戏状态。回执丢失时当前场景保持旧对话，直到下一次 dialogue_version 变化或 NPC 重新初始化

hostClose.effects: generic PanelHost close commit (web lease release, backdrop/HUD resume, pause release)

terminalAvailability.transport: gameCommand (Host->AS2 cmd), sent on every OnClientReady; best-effort single shot, failures log-only
terminalAvailability.source: RagTerminalService.ResolveExePath(): CF7_RAG_EXE env > ragTerminalExePath config > newest CFN-RAG-v*.exe in the install root by LastWriteTimeUtc; an explicitly configured/env path that does not exist returns unavailable without glob fallback
terminalAvailability.semantics: availability only (exe exists); readiness still requires EnsureReady/health + bind. The data/rag JSON probe remains a boot fallback until the Host signal arrives; once received, the Host signal is authoritative

authority.chat: cfn-rag-backend exclusive on http://127.0.0.1:7077, scoped by integration bind slot_key
authority.gameState: none; phase 1 terminal holds no game-state write capability (iframe only talks to exe)
